newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy up to 7,000/T MTBE for Dec.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy up to 7,000/T MTBE for Dec.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has tendered to buy 3,500 to 7,000 tonnes of methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) for December 1-15 delivery, a CPC official said on Friday.
"We can accept an offer for one larger cargo of 7,000 tonnes, if we can do some freight adjustment to the price," the official said.
CPC is seeking offers on a cost-and-freight basis to Keelung or Taichung. The tender closes on November 4 will be valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought 7,000 tonnes in two parcels at $275-$277 a tonne on a c-and-f basis for November 1-15 delivery.
